statement: Kemadruma Yoga (no planet occupying either the 2nd or 12th house from the Moon) is traditionally read as carrying emotional isolation and difficulty gaining sustained support from others — one of the most heavily 'cancellable' yogas in the whole system, so its presence alone is rarely decisive.
editorial_note: Reflects a widely-repeated interpretation found throughout standard Vedic astrological literature, exemplified by (not claimed as a verbatim quotation of) the cited source.
